name: rocky
description: rocky — the owner's personal agent tool: a Rust daemon (shared todo board + streamable HTTP MCP, 127.0.0.1:8636) with this plugin as its thin Claude Code client. Board tools todo_list / todo_write / todo_status / note_list / note_write come from the daemon; worklog_* (append-only local JSONL agent journal, per project) is served by the CLI's stdio MCP server (`rocky mcp worklog`). Hooks: SessionStart boots the daemon (version-aware restart), UserPromptSubmit injects human board changes, Stop claims handoffs and auto-captures the turn into the worklog. Experimental function-hooks module (hooks/lab, on only with a `lab` block in the user rocky.json): toasts for daemon inbox messages, a board band above the prompt, engine rate limits in the status line, /rocky-lab diagnostics. Slash commands: /rocky:next (pick the next board item), /rocky:brainstorm, /rocky:review-request (gate → commit → PR, then optionally chains into /rocky:review-fix per a remembered per-repo choice), /rocky:config (setup check + fill-in), /rocky:usage (usage-log review), /rocky:review-fix, /rocky:recall. Skills: board, pull-request, token-usage, branch-verify, handoff, worklog (how an agent uses rocky), writing-cc-plugin. Subagents: reviewer, quick-fix (Sonnet — judgment-free PR upkeep), merge-cleanup (Haiku — post-merge housekeeping). Absorbed the former rocky-todo plugin/repo.
